**CI:**

Only the quick checks (ruff, isort, docs, submodules) run automatically. The required full-test checks show as "Expected — Waiting for status to be reported" until the full CI has run. A maintainer can comment on this PR:
- `/activate-ci` to run the full test workflows now and on every later push (adds the `ci-active` label),
- `/deactivate-ci` to stop running them on new pushes (removes the label).
